imageNotes: salon-interior.webp: wide salon-room photo (styling stations, mirrors) used twice on index.html — as the framed about-band image (21:9 crop) and in the gated photo_gallery band (4:5 crop, object-position left so a different part of the room shows). salon-chairs.webp: portrait shot of styling chairs by a window, first tile of the gallery band. Both are CC0 photos (see SOURCE.md) and sit under a subtle CSS dark/gold veil (.photo-veil) so they stay inside the black/gold palette. gallery02.jpg and gallery04.jpg are original generated abstract gold-on-black art panels completing the 4-tile gallery. Customer portfolio photos replace the gallery images via the assets pipeline — portrait 4:5 crops display best. No logo image is used; the wordmark is the site_title slot rendered in spaced serif capitals.
